instrument: Ordinance No. O-26-26, Section 4(3) conditional exemption (enacted Sept 21, 2026)
summary: Data centers of 65 IT-megawatts or less may proceed if located in a named industrial park or on a former industrial site and not self-generating power except emergency backup. Exempt projects must submit light-and-glare, noise, and landscaping plans as if all neighboring properties were in a Restrictive Development District, including a noise study establishing pre-construction levels and showing post-construction levels do not increase by more than 10 dB. They may not share a parcel or industrial park with, or sit within one mile of, any other data center, and must enter a development agreement under S.C. Code 6-31-10.
text: Data Centers which will (A) be located (i) in a named industrial park or (ii) on a former industrial site (B) will not self-generate power, except for emergency back-up power and (C) be 65 IT-megawatts or less, and whose primary function is the storage, management and processing of data.

source.citation: Spartanburg County Ordinance No. O-26-26, enacted Sept 21, 2026 (4 pp., signed; provided by Clerk to Council)

notes: CORRECTION: previously RELAYED. Confirms the reported 65 MW (as IT-megawatts), industrial-site and no-self-generation conditions. Reporting understated the anti-clustering clause: it also bars any exempt facility within one (1) mile of any other data center. Not previously reported: the pre-construction noise baseline with a 10 dB post-construction cap, the Restrictive Development District standard applied to neighbors, and the mandatory development agreement. Noise five-element read: limit = relative (+10 dB over measured baseline); measurement standard, weighting and tonal penalty not specified in this ordinance (may be in PZO 2.3.70, not read); measurement by applicant's study; consequence = condition of the application. Superseded by the final third-reading version (Sept 21, 2026); see sc-spartanburg-county-moratorium.
confidence_note: Ordinance read in full. PZO Sections 2.3.70 and 2.3.80 not read.
